title: Choose Jesus Christ Again and Again
author: Elder Karl D. Hirst

footnotes.text: See D. Todd Christofferson, “A Message at Christmas” (Brigham Young University devotional, Dec. 12, 2017), 4, speeches.byu.edu.

President Dallin H. Oaks taught: “Essential to God’s great plan for the mortal growth of His children was for them to experience ‘opposition in all things’ (2 Nephi 2:11). Just as our physical muscles cannot be developed or maintained without straining against the law of gravity, so mortal growth requires us to strain against Satan’s temptations and other mortal opposition. Most important for spiritual growth is the requirement to choose between good and evil” (“Divine Helps for Mortality,”Liahona, May 2025, 104).
Teachings of Presidents of the Church: Ezra Taft Benson(2014),231,232.
Dallin H. Oaks, “Opposition in All Things,”Liahona, May 2016, 115.
